items.html: And at first the parts that Arich has in the seven kings were clarified, and all the rest is called dross relative to him, for they are not of his worth. And however, all that Arich had in them was all clarified at the time of Atzilut, for the correction of AA, and he took it. And from the remaining dross they returned to clarify; then, from the parts that AVI have in them, the aspect of AVI was made. And the rest, in which there were no longer parts of AVI, remained in the secret of dross; and from them they returned to clarify within the womb of Ima.
